canonical_example.translation: My uncle gave me a new book to read.

canonical_example.text: Te voy a brindar un toro, mi amor. - Mejor perdona al toro y cómprame unas flores.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to dedicate a bull to you, my love. - Spare the bull and buy me some flowers.

canonical_example.text: El profesor se brinda a ayudar a los alumnos después de clase.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher is offering to help students after class.

canonical_example.text: Pudo engañar al público con su propaganda.
canonical_example.translation: He was able to deceive the public with his propaganda.

canonical_example.text: Me dijiste que no sabías jugar, ¡me engañaste!
canonical_example.translation: You told me you didn't know how to play. You tricked me!

canonical_example.translation: My ex-boyfriend cheated on me with my best friend.

canonical_example.translation: The used car salesman cheated me.

canonical_example.translation: Don't let him fool you with his charming stories.

canonical_example.translation: She told him she was pregnant in order to trick him into marrying her.

canonical_example.translation: A despicable con man swindled them at the auction.

canonical_example.translation: With three more hours till dinner, she decided to curb her hunger with a snack.

canonical_example.text: El encanto engaña.
canonical_example.translation: Charm is deceptive.

canonical_example.text: Te estás engañando si crees que realmente te van a pagar tanto.
canonical_example.translation: You are fooling yourself if you think they are really going to pay you that much.
